newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Budimex and Stalexport closed higher while BIG, Elektrim and Universal held flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday. Five stocks did not trade.
Total turnover was 1.7 million zlotys, up from Friday's 1.2 million zlotys.
NFI units eased 0.4 percent to 133,5 zlotys in a turnover of 10 million zlotys, down from Friday's 17.7 milion zlotys.
